slides.title: Your holiday brain has 47 open tabs. Close them on one page.
Write every holiday task down
slides.body: Gifts, cards, food, travel, school events. Out of your head and onto paper, no order yet.

slides.title: Sort into 3 boxes
slides.body: This week, later, and not doing it. The third box is the one that frees you up.

slides.title: Things that can go in 'not doing it'
Tape it where you'll see it
slides.body: Fridge, bathroom mirror, front door. If the list is hidden, the list doesn't exist.

slides.title: A holiday plan on paper is quieter than one in your head.
Get the brain dump page
slides.body: The Tidy Brain Printable Pack has a one-page brain dump plus weekly reset lists. Link in bio.
